mainText: This is the Gaza Dispatch audio briefing for July 4, 2026. Here are the key source-backed developments from today's edition. 1. At least 7 Palestinians killed by Israeli forces over past 48 hours in Gaza. A further nine bodies were recovered from under the rubble, according to Gaza's Ministry of Health. This was reported by Al Jazeera. For the full source-backed dispatch, read the July 4, 2026 Gaza edition at dispatches.thebluefernco.com.
